build_ocrvqa_dataset: build an OCR-VQA dataset builder by instantiating OCRVQABuilder to load and process OCR-VQA data
create_ocrvqa_config: create a config path for the OCR-VQA dataset by calling OCRVQABuilder.config_path to get defaults.yaml
register_ocrvqa_builder: register the OCRVQABuilder class with the MMF registry using the register_builder decorator with key ocrvqa
review_ocrvqa_builder_init: review the OCRVQABuilder init method to understand how it sets dataset_name and calls set_dataset_class
test_ocrvqa_update_registry: test the inherited update_registry_for_model method to verify text and answer processor registration for OCR-VQA
